title: Social Media Data Annotation
features: Performed **open coding** on 200+ Reddit posts to design a **topic taxonomy**.
Annotated **600+ posts** for movie-related topics with consistent labels.
Processed datasets using **Python** for CSV parsing, filtering, and splits.
Supported analysis of **movie visibility and reception** through structured data.

title: OKaraoke
features: Built **OKaraoke**, a website turning YouTube links into karaoke with lyric alignment and pitch scoring.
Developed animated **Cover, Loading, and Scoring UI** with TypeScript, Tailwind, and DaisyUI.
Implemented **Python audio processing** with Aubio for MIDI conversion and pitch extraction.
Compared **microphone input** to MIDI data for real-time pitch scoring.

title: Web Scraping Trending News
features: Built a **Python scraper** using requests and BeautifulSoup to extract 5 trending news articles.
Implemented **HTML caching** with 1-hour expiry and custom User-Agent headers.
Parsed and cleaned article data into a structured **JSON output**.
